```{r}
csu_lib  <- import_msp_csu(system.file("extdata", "CSUPMF_C8_lib", "CSUPMF_C8_lib.mspLib", package = "MS1Match"))


```


```{r}
length(csu_lib)
csu_lib[[1]]$Peaks
```

```{r}
csu_lib_summary <- summarize_peak_mz_cpp(csu_lib = csu_lib)
```

```{r}
csu_lib_summary
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

csu_pct_summary <- csu_lib_summary %>%
  mutate(
    pct_below_or_equal = 100 * (n_below + n_around + n_isotope) / n_total,
    pct_above = 100 * n_above / n_total
  ) %>%
  arrange(pct_below_or_equal) %>%  # sort by percentage of smaller/equal
  mutate(Compound = factor(Compound, levels = unique(Compound)))

plot_df <- csu_lib_summary %>%
  group_by(Compound, Adduct) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_below_or_equal = mean(100 * (n_below + n_around + n_isotope) / n_total),
    pct_above = mean(100 * n_above / n_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_pct = pct_below_or_equal + pct_above,
    pct_below_or_equal = 100 * pct_below_or_equal / total_pct,
    pct_above = 100 * pct_above / total_pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(pct_below_or_equal) %>%
  mutate(Compound = factor(Compound, levels = unique(Compound))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(pct_below_or_equal, pct_above),
    names_to = "Region",
    values_to = "Percent"
  )

```


```{r}
Peak_distribution_CSU <-ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Compound, y = Percent, fill = Region)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Adduct, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1,
             labeller = labeller(Adduct = c(
               "[M+H]+" = "[M+H]+",
               "[M+Na]+" = "[M+Na]+",
               "Unknown" = "No PI Found"
             ))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "#4E79A7", "pct_above" = "#E15759"),
    labels = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "≤ PI m/z", "pct_above" = "> PI m/z")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Peak Distribution by PI Type CSUPMF library",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of Peaks",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "gray50")
  )

Peak_distribution_CSU

# ggsave("Peak Distribution by PI Type CSUPMF library.png", Peak_distribution_CSU, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  

```
## Summarize the percentage distribution of peaks


```{r}
summary_stats <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Adduct, Region) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct = mean(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pct = median(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pct = sd(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_pct = min(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pct = max(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Adduct, Region)
summary_stats
```

```{r}
boxplot_CSU <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Adduct, y = Percent, fill = Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "#4E79A7", "pct_above" = "#E15759"),
    labels = c("pct_below_or_equal" = "≤ PI m/z", "pct_above" = "> PI m/z")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Peak Percentages by PI Type",
    x = "PI Type",
    y = "Percentage of Peaks",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)

boxplot_CSU
```
